method_note: Counted the 15 oral technical sessions of the 7th ISSS (TU Delft, 30 Jun-4 Jul 2025) in the official Final Programme, with 53 talks. The keynote (ACS3 flight lessons), the two invited special sessions ('Space-Based Geoengineering', 'Space-Based Solar Power') and the poster session (17 posters, several duplicating oral talks) were excluded. Each session = 1 unit split across at most 2 keywords. Sail-as-propulsion performance and concept sessions map to space-propulsion. Sailcraft design/deployment maps to deployable-structures. TS2 (flight-readiness of Solar Cruiser, CubeSat light sails and a drag-sail module) is split deployable-structures/smallsat. TS10 (sail and solar-array membranes) is split deployable-structures/structures. T12 (large membrane and origami deployable reflectors, orbit-structure coupling) is split deployable-structures/astrodynamics. No keyword fell below 0.02.
